company.description: Adentris provides an AI-powered platform for healthcare documentation compliance, real-time EMR audit, and revenue cycle optimization. The company integrates with hospital electronic health record systems to monitor notes, orders, results, and workflows as clinicians document. Its compliance engine interprets thousands of regulatory rules, detects missing, conflicting, or late documentation elements, and flags issues linked to quality, billing, and regulatory measures. Adentris initiates targeted, in-workflow tasks for physicians, nurses, and compliance teams so gaps such as missing discharge notes, timing errors, or incomplete assessments can be corrected before discharge or claim submission. A billing and revenue cycle module transforms compliant documentation into cleaner claims to reduce denials and revenue leakage. An AI web agent layer enables clinical chart-level access across diverse EMR systems without relying solely on custom API integrations. The platform is used by hospitals and treatment centers to support quality programs, value-based payment measures, and audit readiness.
